note: REQ-0207. Three authored layouts on the placeable area B2:Y17. A member's `at` is its A1 TOP-LEFT anchor; occupied cells derive from the enemy footprint (shared/content_validate.cjs cellsFor) and are never stored. Melee forward-left, support behind, boss center-left.

entries.name: Wild Hunt
entries.note: Lifesteal tempo: fast melee (alpha_werewolf rending/feral, dire_wolf, boar tusk) sustains through damage via feral_bite while the giant bat's blood_drain feeds from the flank.

entries.name: Venom Nest
entries.note: Poison engine: giant_spider (venom_bite) and giant_snake (venom_spit) stack Poison, then giant_scorpion (stinger) and basilisk (toxic_maw) cash it in via bonus_vs_status x1.5.

entries.name: Demon Gate
entries.note: Burn engine: the imps (fire_dart) and demon_lord (dominion_of_flame) set the squad alight, then gargoyle (molten_talons) converts Burn x1.5 while dullahan anchors the gate.
